answer: Reaching the quill of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the copper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work.
